This ultra-compact portable speaker delivers 15W of output and 92 dB peak loudness. BassUp 2.0 produces deep, punchy bass that defies its small size.
Up to 24 hours of playtime on a single charge, from sunrise to sunset. The real-time power display shows the exact battery level, so low power never catches you out.
The dual-slot strap switches between clip mode for a backpack or bike and strap mode for carrying. Soft, tear-resistant silicone holds it securely in any outdoor setting.
Certified IP68 for complete dust and water protection and tested to withstand drops of up to 1 meter (3.28 ft).
Choose from 6 music-synced light modes and 8 ambient options, then dial in EQ presets tuned for hip-hop, pop, rock and more.
When you are out and cannot plug in, the speaker can keep your phone going in a pinch, which helps with maps, photos and urgent calls.
Built by Anker, the world's number one charging brand, trusted by more than 80 million users worldwide.
